submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively at the initial token or piece of a predictable multi-token lexical unit: the first subword of a morphologically complex word (isomer, ischaemic, isomaltulose, doxorubicin, inelastic, bloodless, cardiomyopathy), the first half of a hyphenated compound (to-do, on-chip, boy-scout), or the first word of a fixed collocation (credit card, run feature, not for profit, and electronic). The same starter token stays quiet when its bound continuation is missing (bloody vs bloodless, elastic vs inelastic) or when the left context does not license that specific unit (danger vs safety of isomaltulose), while changes that preserve the stem-plus-continuation structure or touch only distant tokens leave it unchanged.
